conflicts.where: Lesson 4 (Overview and 'What learners observed'), compared with the Part 3 exemplar
conflicts.problem: Lesson 4 says the small cone (h = 120 cm) sits 'on top of the bucket'. Bucket C is widest at the top (R = 21 cm), so the sides meet at an apex below the narrow 28 cm base. The small removed cone lies below the bucket, not on top of it. With R = 21, r = 14 and h = 60, the numbers (120 cm, 180 cm, 24,640 cm³, 83,160 cm³) are correct, but the placement description is wrong.
